status: Next-data design, not a validated signal; short bounded capture only, no scheduled or continuous collector
capture: Public spot orderbook.50 and publicTrade for fixed symbols; record complete original messages, arrival wallclock and monotonic elapsed time, snapshot/delta, exchange ts/cts, trade T/i/seq and RPI flag. Never drop trade messages sharing a seq; each may contain different trades. All observations, not just successful alerts, must be retained.
reconstruction_required_before_modelling: Start from snapshot; replace on each new snapshot including service restart; apply per-price delta quantities, removing zero quantity. Invalidate connection gaps until new snapshot. Check timestamps, update ordering, non-crossed positive bid/ask, and displayed-depth coverage. Update IDs/cross-sequences must not be assumed contiguous without documented guarantee. Do not infer cancellations from size reductions alone. Preserve raw feed for audit.

fixed_initial_hypotheses.ask_depletion: After elevated aggressive buy notional, does displayed ask notional within25bp of a fixed anchor midprice decline and remain depleted over the following60seconds? Count executed buy flow separately; compare with equally active unsuccessful episodes.
fixed_initial_hypotheses.bid_replenishment: After sell-heavy trades, does displayed bid depth within25bp of the fixed anchor midprice recover over60seconds while midprice remains within the fixed downside bound? RPI trades and non-RPI trades analyzed separately because standard book excludes RPI.
fixed_initial_hypotheses.liquidity_cost: From the observed ask ladder estimate notional needed to reach anchor mid+25bp, only if captured levels cover that price. Test its change before surge; unavailable coverage is missing, not zero. Account for spread and compare price path under similar buy notional.

evaluation: Before a new evaluation period, fix universe, event definition, one feature per hypothesis, lookback and alert policy. Use initial calibration block to set scales only; lock before later block, purge overlapping event horizons, preserve same-coin hard negatives and day/market context. Report precision, event recall, lead, alerts/day, adverse excursion and simulated execution costs separately. Decide required independent event count using a stated minimally useful precision/recall and uncertainty target, not an arbitrary number of days.
scope_limitations: The recorder only stores messages and capture health. It does not yet reconstruct order books, reconnect automatically, rotate long-running files or generate these features. Those require implementation and validation before unattended continuous collection or prediction. A brief sample proves connectivity only.
